title: Raw transaction call and contract-event inspection qualification
objective: Qualify Explorer repository service/API presentation of raw transaction call context and complete receipt/block log payloads, preserving indexed provenance while failing closed on malformed populated value/input/topic/data/address fields.

owns: transaction valueWei and raw input presentation
complete topic values and raw data serialization
does_not_own: ABI-decoded function names or revert reasons
deployed browser rendering of raw event payloads

defects_remediated: Explorer TransactionSummary omitted indexed valueWei and input fields required for raw failed-call inspection
Explorer transaction/block detail exposed raw model.LogRecord directly without a stable presentation contract
Explorer did not fail closed on malformed populated raw transaction input, log address, topic, or data fields
acceptance_criteria: AC-1 transaction/receipt/log repository APIs expose complete raw indexed context
AC-5 raw call and event presentation preserves block/transaction/log provenance
AC-7 malformed populated raw payloads fail closed rather than being presented as inspectable chain data
AC-8 Explorer remains a non-authoritative projection consumer and raw values remain primary to future decoded labels
qualification_tests: reverted transaction preserves status, raw calldata, and valueWei
multi-topic event preserves every topic value and raw data
malformed odd-length log data fails closed
malformed populated log address fails closed
block detail uses the same validated raw event presentation
Explorer HTTP transaction and block APIs serialize raw call/event fields

qualification_evidence.exact_head_policy: The evidence-recording commit must itself pass the exact-head EXP-2.5 and retained qualification suite before the milestone is marked COMPLETE.
